topic: Safe Use and Care of Household Materials
key_concepts: Household cleaning can be done with soap, water, and chlorox
Items with hazard symbols should be stored out of children's reach
Read and follow the label before using chemicals
Unknown liquids should never be tasted
Wash hands after using hazardous household materials
Close chemical containers tightly after use
Leave the area or cover the nose when insecticide is sprayed indoors
Flammable materials can cause fire and should not be played with
Some tools like knives require adult supervision
Pesticide spraying without protective gear may cause illness
Chemicals are labeled so their contents can be known and used properly
